summary: A wellness coach appears to lose clients to a 2022 footer, a free builder address and an ended program still shown on the booking page, with Black Friday on 27 November.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say 2022 and the site runs on a free Wix address with the Wix advert at the top.
findings.cost: A date four years old and a builder advert make a visitor wonder if the coach is still active, and people pay active coaches, not dormant ones.
findings.fix: Current footer, your own domain, no builder advert.

findings.problem: The booking page lists Group Wellness Coaching as Ended, with Subject to Package under it, next to the live 15 minute and 90 dollar sessions.
findings.cost: A product marked as ended on the page where people book makes the whole page look abandoned and confuses buyers about what they can buy.
findings.fix: Remove ended items, show only what is on sale.

findings.problem: The only offers appear to be a free 15 minute call and one 90 dollar session, with no Black Friday package, and the contact is a phone number and a gmail address with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: On Black Friday a clear bundle sells, and a client who wants to send a quick message has no easy way to do it.
findings.fix: A Black Friday package page and a one tap message button.

redesign: Clean booking page, no ended items.
Black Friday package and one tap message.
